mentl/4eb4f21:
The mechanism is complete. $go is bound twice in m2's parse_int and once
in m3, and the order carries the fault: m2 sets at body line 19 and first
reads at 21; m3 has no set before its first read at line 20, its only set
landing at 32. The local is zero at that read, and that zero is the
closure the tail call dispatches on — use-before-def ending in indirect
call type mismatch. The full unwindowed diff of the body is seven lines:
two index-global renames, one comment rename, and one pure deletion with
no counterpart.

The near-retraction is recorded because the recovery is the lesson.
Mid-iteration a census of local.set lines appeared to show the binding
present in both generations, which would have refuted the whole finding,
and I began writing the retraction. That census filtered out any line
containing state_tmp — and the dropped line is
`(local.set $go (local.get $state_tmp))`. The filter excluded exactly the
evidence.

Three instruments, two of them lying in opposite directions: a windowed
diff showed a deletion and could not prove the absence of a counterpart
elsewhere; a filtered census showed presence and had silently dropped the
line; only the unwindowed diff plus the positional read were true. The
law says measure rather than reason, and this adds the corollary — a
measurement's filter is part of the claim, and an instrument that
excludes the evidence reads exactly like a refutation.

Next step is a build with a precise target: find what drops the first
binding when a nested fn's name qualifies. The LLet emit always writes
its local.set, so the loss is upstream, in a lowering or dedup decision
that treats the binding as redundant once the name changes.

Boot unchanged; docs only.

mentl/4e8e18e:
The census-3 trio's banked diagnosis (rounds lose the subtraction) was
refuted by measurement: old judge on new source reports zero, and the
minimal repro fails under both judges, so the deepest root predates the
convergence loop. Five roots, each measured before fixed:

- subst_row's bound-tail arm dropped the pending mask's absent set, so
  an effect-polymorphic bracket's subtraction died at instantiation
  (bracket(() => ping()) leaked Ping to a Pure caller).
- The closure creation edge charged a lambda's whole row to its
  creator, a mint-time-evidence relic; under world-as-value dispatch a
  thunk performs where called, so abstraction is pure, the row rides
  the closure's type, and the call edge charges appliers. Deleted.
- The call and pipe edges shared a top-level loose scheme's raw row
  handle into the caller's frame, the pre-convergence forward-ref
  crutch. The share-guard keys on FnScheme; params and locals keep the
  polymorphic share; the rounds iterate forward-ref truth instead.
- The round prepass re-minted every handler sig unconditionally while
  the cone masked the decl's judgment out, flipping entries between
  bare and resolved forever. The prepass is cone-gated now.
- The T-handle row-var class: the loose pre-registration mints
  function-type row vars as type handles, and the sort-blind
  row_var_is_free made both of infer_context's scheme row tails
  invisible to quantification while subst_row's catch-all shared them.
  Every caller chained one live row; the first binder's thunk row
  became the E_EffectMismatch quartet. The three-walk tolerance
  (free/changes/build agree on NFree in row position) closes it.

Zero row mismatches in the whole self-compile, the rounds converge
inside the bound, and the incremental cone re-judges only stmts whose
fingerprints moved. The march ruled TRANSITION (m3 == m4); boot
re-pinned; the census ratchet returns to 0. Micros mn-absorb-poly and
mn-absorb-poly-fwd bank both faces, seen red through the prior pin
mentl/4e35c48:
The adversarial pass split the six payload micros into two roots the
spec-twin design could not jointly reach: three floor inside the arm
fn (the last named-generic-at-the-decl-floor class), three floor in
main on the handle-result read with word-shuttle arms — that root is
the row's fragment drop (two ops of one effect in one non-install
frame lose the second fragment's args to the by-name dedup). The
replacement completes existing channels: L1 lets same-named fragments
coexist until the install reconciles them; L2 emits the arm under its
installs' instantiation through the existing spec bracket, with a
loud refusal on divergent floor-sensitive installs. Ranked queue
trued; the six 134 expectations are the red gates.
mentl/4e3faa7:
The paren-orphaning fix (the eq/compare sum-fold helpers emitted )))))
one paren over, closing the module early and cascading a wall of phantom
undefined errors from the orphaned tail) let m3.wat parse whole for the
first time. The census that surfaced was complete at four refs in two
classes, each fixed at root:

  Float: the parser accepts a variant payload only after '(', so
  TapeVecAdd { ... } orphaned the record-type brace, which the outer
  parser misread as a value literal, lowering the field type [Float] as
  a value whose element is the bare type name Float. autodiff's variants
  now use the canonical parenthesized payload TapeVecAdd({ ... }),
  matching their own construction sites.

  wasi_num_cores: it has a wasi_threads handler arm, so it is an
  effect-op perform, not a raw import. Removed from is_wasi_import_op; it
  routes through lower_perform_dispatch now, matching the seed's op-index
  dispatch.

  atomic_load_i32 / wait_i32: direct-substrate atomic instructions with
  no handler arm, emitted as dangling calls. They project to
  i32.atomic.load / memory.atomic.wait32 now (the latter extending the
  i32 timeout to the instruction's i64), the threading peer of the
  existing memory-op instruction projections.

is_wasi_import_op had conflated three substrates (host imports,
effect-ops-with-handlers, atomic instructions), all emitting call $op.
Each emits its true form now.

m2 and m3 build clean; m3.wat has zero undefined functions or globals.
The trap marched to the f64/i64 representation gradient (44 type
mismatches in emit_const / lower_lit_value / path_open FFI): the seed
floors floats to i32 so m2 assembles, but the wheel's real f64 emit is
internally inconsistent between local declarations and value widths.
That is the next frontier.

Carries the seed mirrors for faces 7 and 14 (alloc wrap-trap; rest-slot
presence-vs-binding) that this build depended on.

two-top/4e8f5f7:
input_desktop now reads gamepads alongside the keyboard: first pad drives
P0, second drives P1 (left stick move, South/RTrigger throw, East/LTrigger
dash), with a deadzone-rescaled analog stick sharing the keyboard's
wire_input core. A pad overrides its scheme only while active, so the
keyboard stays a live fallback. apply_deadzone + analog quantization are
unit-tested (8 cases total).

The gilrs backend pulls libudev-sys (needs libudev dev headers on Linux),
so it's gated behind an opt-in 'gamepad' cargo feature — the default
keyboard build needs no system libs. The gamepad-reading code is always
compiled (Bevy 'gamepad' type feature, no system dep); without the backend
the pad query is simply empty. Build controllers in with:
  cargo run -p app --features gamepad   (+ libudev-devel on Linux)
